title: Input Order Shapes LLM Semantic Alignment in Multi-Document Summarization
reasoning: The study focuses on structural position bias (specifically the primacy effect) in LLMs. Although it uses a dataset of news articles concerning abortion—a topic with significant moral and ethical dimensions—the research evaluates the model's semantic alignment and weighting of input documents based on their sequence, rather than benchmarking or evaluating ethical, moral, or religious frameworks.
